description: Runtime knobs. Edit freely; the routine reads these on every run.

trading_window.description: Signals generated only within this GMT window

macro_kill_switches.description: If VIX > vix_max, issue WAIT on all stocks regardless of other signals

risk.description: Minimum risk:reward ratio. If target is not at least 2x the stop, skip the trade.

confluence.description: 5-6 confirms = HIGH confidence, 4 = MEDIUM confidence, <=3 = WAIT

earnings.description: Never signal within this many trading days of an earnings event
